title: 会社の10年推移
question: この会社の売上・営業利益・純利益は直近10年でどう動いたか
note: 金額は円。最新期は決算発表前だと空欄になることがある。

title: 業種別の営業利益率
question: どの業種が儲かっているか（営業利益率の業種平均と社数）
sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(industry, '(不明)') AS industry_name, operating_margin
  FROM m_fin_annual
  WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND operating_margin BETWEEN -1 AND 1
)
SELECT industry_name, ROUND(AVG(operating_margin) * 100, 2) AS avg_operating_margin_pct, COUNT(*) AS companies
FROM d
GROUP BY industry_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= {{min_companies}}
ORDER BY avg_operating_margin_pct DESC
note: 単純平均（社の大きさは加味しない）。営業利益率が±100%を超える外れ値は除く。

title: 売上3年成長率の上位
question: 3年前から売上を最も伸ばした会社は
sql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT edinet_code, sec_code4, name, industry, fiscal_year, net_sales,
         LAG(net_sales, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY edinet_code ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS sales_3y_ago,
         LAG(fiscal_year, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY edinet_code ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS year_3y_ago
  FROM m_fin_annual
  WHERE net_sales IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT sec_code4, name, industry, sales_3y_ago, net_sales,
       ROUND((net_sales / NULLIF(sales_3y_ago, 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS growth_3y_pct
FROM w
WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND year_3y_ago = fiscal_year - 3 AND sales_3y_ago >= {{min_sales}}
ORDER BY growth_3y_pct DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}
note: 3年前の決算が欠けている会社は対象外（行の並びではなく年で3年前を確認している）。合併・買収による増加も含む。

title: 増収増益企業数の年次推移
question: 売上も営業利益も前年より増えた会社は毎年どれだけあるか
sql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT edinet_code, fiscal_year, net_sales, operating_income,
         LAG(net_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY edinet_code ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_sales,
         LAG(operating_income) OVER (PARTITION BY edinet_code ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_op,
         LAG(fiscal_year) OVER (PARTITION BY edinet_code ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_year
  FROM m_fin_annual
  WHERE net_sales IS NOT NULL AND operating_income IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT fiscal_year,
       COUNT(*) AS companies,
       SUM(CASE WHEN net_sales > prev_sales AND operating_income > prev_op THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS up_up_companies,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN net_sales > prev_sales AND operating_income > prev_op THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS up_up_pct
FROM w
WHERE prev_year = fiscal_year - 1 AND fiscal_year BETWEEN {{from_year}} AND {{to_year}}
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year
note: 前年の決算が両方そろう会社だけが母数。母数は年によって変わるので割合も併記。

title: 業種別の平均年収
question: 業種ごとの平均年間給与（万円）
sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(industry, '(不明)') AS industry_name, avg_annual_salary
  FROM m_fin_annual
  WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND avg_annual_salary > 0
)
SELECT industry_name, ROUND(AVG(avg_annual_salary) / 10000, 0) AS avg_salary_man_yen, COUNT(*) AS companies
FROM d
GROUP BY industry_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= {{min_companies}}
ORDER BY avg_salary_man_yen DESC
note: 有報の「平均年間給与」（提出会社単体・持株会社は社員が少なく高く出ることがある）。

title: フリーCF黒字企業の割合
question: フリーキャッシュフローが黒字の会社は毎年どれだけあるか
sql:
SELECT fiscal_year,
       COUNT(*) AS companies,
       SUM(CASE WHEN free_cf > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fcf_positive,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN free_cf > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS fcf_positive_pct
FROM m_fin_annual
WHERE free_cf IS NOT NULL AND fiscal_year BETWEEN {{from_year}} AND {{to_year}}
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year
note: フリーCF＝営業CF＋投資CF（財務データの定義）。

title: 自己資本比率の分布
question: 自己資本比率はどの区間に何社いるか
sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN equity_ratio < 0 THEN 0
              WHEN equity_ratio < 0.2 THEN 1
              WHEN equity_ratio < 0.4 THEN 2
              WHEN equity_ratio < 0.6 THEN 3
              WHEN equity_ratio < 0.8 THEN 4
              ELSE 5 END AS bucket_no,
         CASE WHEN equity_ratio < 0 THEN '債務超過'
              WHEN equity_ratio < 0.2 THEN '0〜20%'
              WHEN equity_ratio < 0.4 THEN '20〜40%'
              WHEN equity_ratio < 0.6 THEN '40〜60%'
              WHEN equity_ratio < 0.8 THEN '60〜80%'
              ELSE '80%以上' END AS bucket
  FROM m_fin_annual
  WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND equity_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT bucket_no, bucket, COUNT(*) AS companies
FROM d
GROUP BY bucket_no, bucket
ORDER BY bucket_no
note: 自己資本比率＝純資産(equity)÷総資産。銀行・保険は構造上低く出る。

title: 配当性向の分布
question: 配当性向はどの区間に何社いるか
sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN payout_ratio <= 0 THEN 0
              WHEN payout_ratio < 0.2 THEN 1
              WHEN payout_ratio < 0.4 THEN 2
              WHEN payout_ratio < 0.6 THEN 3
              WHEN payout_ratio < 1 THEN 4
              ELSE 5 END AS bucket_no,
         CASE WHEN payout_ratio <= 0 THEN '無配・0%'
              WHEN payout_ratio < 0.2 THEN '0〜20%'
              WHEN payout_ratio < 0.4 THEN '20〜40%'
              WHEN payout_ratio < 0.6 THEN '40〜60%'
              WHEN payout_ratio < 1 THEN '60〜100%'
              ELSE '100%以上' END AS bucket
  FROM m_fin_annual
  WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND payout_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT bucket_no, bucket, COUNT(*) AS companies
FROM d
GROUP BY bucket_no, bucket
ORDER BY bucket_no
note: 配当性向は連結ベースの自前計算値（小数）。赤字で配当を出す会社は100%以上に入る。

title: ROE × PBR 散布図
question: ROEが高い会社ほどPBRも高いか
sql:
SELECT sec_code4, name, COALESCE(industry, '(不明)') AS industry_name,
       ROUND(roe * 100, 2) AS roe_pct, ROUND(pbr, 2) AS pbr
FROM m_fin_annual
WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND roe BETWEEN -0.5 AND 0.6 AND pbr > 0 AND pbr <= {{max_pbr}}
note: PBRは有報記載の期末ベース。ROEが-50%〜60%の範囲だけを描く。

title: 粗利率と販管費率の業種比較
question: 業種ごとの粗利率と販管費率の違い
sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(industry, '(不明)') AS industry_name, gross_margin, sga_ratio
  FROM m_fin_annual
  WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND gross_margin BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND sga_ratio BETWEEN 0 AND 1
)
SELECT industry_name,
       ROUND(AVG(gross_margin) * 100, 1) AS avg_gross_margin_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(sga_ratio) * 100, 1) AS avg_sga_ratio_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS companies
FROM d
GROUP BY industry_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= {{min_companies}}
ORDER BY avg_gross_margin_pct DESC
note: 粗利と販管費の両方を開示している会社だけ。粗利を開示しない業種（銀行・一部サービス）は出ない。

title: 赤字企業数の推移
question: 純損失の会社は毎年どれだけあるか
sql:
SELECT fiscal_year,
       COUNT(*) AS companies,
       SUM(CASE WHEN net_income < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_companies,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN net_income < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS loss_pct
FROM m_fin_annual
WHERE net_income IS NOT NULL AND fiscal_year BETWEEN {{from_year}} AND {{to_year}}
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year
note: 純利益＝親会社株主に帰属する当期純利益で判定。

title: 従業員数の増減ランキング
question: 前年から従業員が最も増えた（減った）会社は
sql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT edinet_code, sec_code4, name, industry, fiscal_year, employee_count,
         LAG(employee_count) OVER (PARTITION BY edinet_code ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_count,
         LAG(fiscal_year) OVER (PARTITION BY edinet_code ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_year
  FROM m_fin_annual
  WHERE employee_count > 0
)
SELECT sec_code4, name, industry, prev_count, employee_count,
       employee_count - prev_count AS change_count,
       ROUND((employee_count * 1.0 / prev_count - 1) * 100, 1) AS change_pct
FROM w
WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND prev_year = fiscal_year - 1 AND prev_count >= {{min_employees}}
ORDER BY change_count DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}

params.name: min_employees
params.label: 前年の従業員数の下限

note: 連結従業員数。M&Aや連結範囲の変更でも大きく動く。減少上位は並びを昇順にして見る。

title: 業種のROE推移
question: この業種のROEの平均は年ごとにどう動いたか
sql:
SELECT fiscal_year,
       ROUND(AVG(roe) * 100, 2) AS avg_roe_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS companies
FROM m_fin_annual
WHERE industry = {{industry}} AND roe BETWEEN -1 AND 1
GROUP BY fiscal_year
HAVING COUNT(*) >= {{min_companies}}
ORDER BY fiscal_year
note: 業種名は東証33業種に近い表記（m_company.industry と同じ値）。ROEが±100%を超える外れ値は除く。

title: 業種別の女性管理職比率
question: 女性管理職の比率が高い業種は
sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(industry, '(不明)') AS industry_name, female_manager_ratio
  FROM m_fin_annual
  WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND female_manager_ratio BETWEEN 0 AND 1
)
SELECT industry_name, ROUND(AVG(female_manager_ratio) * 100, 1) AS avg_female_manager_pct, COUNT(*) AS companies
FROM d
GROUP BY industry_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= {{min_companies}}
ORDER BY avg_female_manager_pct DESC
note: 開示が義務化された2023年3月期以降が中心。それ以前は母数が少ない。

title: 売上高ランキング
question: 売上が大きい会社の一覧（営業利益率つき）
sql:
SELECT sec_code4, name, industry, net_sales, operating_income,
       ROUND(operating_margin * 100, 2) AS operating_margin_pct
FROM m_fin_annual
WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND net_sales IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}
